tasks.description: Developing a real-time, interactive web app where guests collaborate to assemble a hidden gender reveal image.
Implemented QR code-based room joining and state persistence, allowing users to rejoin a session if disconnected.
Developed a backend using Node.js with Express and SQLite for managing products and cart functionality.
Implemented a responsive frontend with Next.js and Material UI, incorporating Zustand for state management and Tailwind CSS for layout adjustments.
Learned Node.js and Material UI, and completed the project in 3 days.
Developed a frontend-only contract pricing platform with dynamic cost calculations and PDF generation.
Utilized Session Storage for temporary data storage, ensuring a smooth user experience.
